rules.title: Risk Management & Maximum Drawdown Policy
rules.content:
All accounts are subject to a strict 20% Maximum Trailing Drawdown, calculated against the highest recorded account equity (High-Water Mark).

The High-Water Mark (HWM) is dynamic and adjusts upward as profits increase
The maximum loss threshold moves upward with profit growth and does not decrease under any circumstance
At no time may account equity fall 20% below its highest recorded level
Breach Consequence: If the drawdown limit is breached at any time, the account will be automatically liquidated and permanently terminated
No reinstatement or reset will be permitted

rules.title: Trade Execution & Market Conduct Standards
rules.content:
Policy: All executed trades must be held open for a minimum of 240 seconds (4 minutes).

Violation: Trades closed in under 240 seconds will be considered invalid. Profits generated from such trades will be voided and deducted from the account balance.

Repeated violations may result in account termination.

rules.title: Account Activity & Dormancy Policy
rules.content:
Policy: The Trader must execute at least one valid trade within every 48-hour continuous period.

Technical Requirement: This is a strict requirement from our liquidity providers to maintain server allocation.

Consequence: Accounts inactive for more than 48 hours are automatically flagged for archival and deletion. Restoration is not possible.

rules.title: Payout Policy & Profit Cap
rules.content:
Profit Split: 70% to the Trader / 30% to the Platform.

Eligibility: Payout requests may be initiated only after achieving a minimum of 10% net profit.

Maximum Profit Cap: The maximum withdrawable profit per cycle is capped at 50% of the starting account equity.

Procedure: Upon reaching the 50% profit cap, trading is temporarily suspended, and a mandatory withdrawal of the Trader's share (70%) is processed. The account is then reset to the initial balance.

rules.title: Fee Policy
rules.content:
All fees are non-refundable once trading activity has commenced (i.e., upon execution of the first trade).

Risk Warning
Trading leveraged financial instruments involves substantial risk and may result in significant losses. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
Participation in the NairaFunded program indicates full understanding and acceptance of all trading rules, termination clauses, and risk disclosures outlined above.

rules.title: Refund & Risk Policy
rules.content:
Service Nature: The fee paid is for an Evaluation Service and access to a simulated trading environment. It is not an investment deposit.

No Refunds: All fees are non-refundable once the service has commenced (first trade executed).

Risk Warning: Trading involves substantial risk of loss. Past performance is not indicative of future results.
